entities.name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
entities.description: Cat warrior of the Khyyiani tribe and leader of a five-member squad, summoned from Jamuraa to the Red Iron Mountains.

entities.name: Khyyiani
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe of the Sukurvian Desert.

entities.name: Red Iron Mountains
entities.description: Mountains in Aerona where Kyyrao was summoned.

entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: Man who lost his memory, defeated Kyyrao's warriors, and was taken as Kyyrao's mate.

entities.name: Shinra
entities.description: One of Kyyrao's warriors who attacked Loot.

entities.name: Dreadfang
entities.description: Broodlord of a gang of kobolds, killed by Kyyrao and later reanimated.

entities.name: Peregrinator Complex
entities.description: Site of the quest where the reanimated broodlord was killed.

entities.name: Cat Warriors
entities.description: Warriors who took responsibility for Loot and nursed him back to health.

events.summary: Shinra attacks Loot, thinking him easy prey; Loot easily fights him off and also defeats Kyyrao.
events.quote: Loot easily fought him off, Kyyrao tried to fight him, but she, too, was defeated.

events.summary: The Cat Warriors take responsibility for Loot and nurse him back to health.
events.quote: the Cat Warriors decided to take responsibility for him and nurse him back to health

events.summary: Upon waking, Kyyrao takes Loot for her mate.
events.quote: Upon waking, Kyyrao took Loot for her mate.

events.summary: Kyyrao kills Dreadfang, broodlord of the kobolds bothering Grover's.
events.quote: She killed Dreadfang , the broodlord of a gang of kobolds that were bothering Grover's

events.summary: A year later Kyyrao joins Loot's quest to the Peregrinator Complex, where they kill the reanimated broodlord.
events.quote: where they killed the reanimated broodlord

relations.quote: Kyyrao took Loot for her mate.
She was the leader of a five-member squad of warriors.
